profile.headline: Software Engineer - Shift4 Payments
profile.summary: Full Stack Web Developer and Database manager with experience in ASP.NET(HTML, CSS, JavaScript, C#), REACT.Js, Node.js, express.js, jQuery, SQL, Microsoft Azure. B.S. in Biological Sciences, Anatomy and Physiology from California Polytechnic State University-San Luis Obispo; extensive lab experience through coursework in cellular biology, developmental biology, immunology, hematology, chemistry, and biochemistry; experience working in teams as well as leading them; mastery of data analytics software JMP and Minitab as well as Microsoft Office

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States · Remote
positions.description:
●	Design, develop and support ASP.NET MVC websites using C# for internal administration, client-facing administration, and customer-facing eCommerce
●	Design, develop and support multiple RESTful APIs used by both internal and external to Shift4 systems
●	Manage multiple Azure AppServices and SQL databases hosted on Microsoft Azure containing sensitive customer data, stored value and loyalty transaction information, stored value and loyalty accounts, and eCommerce order information
●	Facilitate third-party POS and website integrations with the Shift4 TCC Gift Card and Loyalty platform, including initial discovery, development support, and certification testing
●	Develop, test and provide support for POS integration applications written in C# on Oracle Micros Simphony and Oracle Micros RES
●	Create and maintain technical, support, and sales documentation for various Shift4 products and services
●	Collaborate with sales team to provide solution recommendations to hospitality clients looking to implement stored value and/or loyalty solutions utilizing Customer Relationship Management (CRM) databases to store sensitive customer information securely
●	Provide on-call technical and database support

positions.description: Provided guests with exceptional service to ensure guests received an optimal shopping experience, Handled guest service situations in which professionalism and guest service must have been upheld despite the circumstances of the situation, Managed inventory and product displays
